title: Beautiful Bakeware!
text: Beautiful Bakeware!. This is beautiful bakeware! My daughter is in college and moving into a new apartment this summer. She needs some basic kitchen stuff. She's not going to have a dishwasher, so the fact that these are hand wash only isn't an issue. The pieces are sturdy and feel tough enough for normal cooking and baking. They look great, too!

product_metadata.title: Spice by Tia Mowry Healthy Nonstick Ceramic Savory Saffron 6 Piece Carbon Steel Bakeware Set - Assorted Colors (96227.06RR)
features: WHAT'S IN THE BOX: Set includes two 8-inch round cake pans, one loaf pan, one 6-cup muffin pan, one 13-inch bake pan, one 15-inch cookie sheet
NONSTICK CERAMIC INTERIOR: Easy-to-clean, nonstick ceramic surface that requires less oil when baking
CARBON STEEL EXTERIOR: Absorbs and distributes heat evenly to achieve baking and browning perfection
ROLLED EDGES: Resist warping and offer extra support on its easy-grip handles
COLORFUL BAKING ESSENTIALS: Available in assorted colors that make baking more fun and enjoyable
description: Bake with confidence with the Spice by Tia Mowry Nonstick Ceramic 6-piece Carbon Steel Baking Set. Crafted from carbon steel, each baking pan distributes heat evenly, helping you serve up a perfect batch of cookies, cupcakes, and other baked goods. It also offers easy, healthy baking choices from its nonstick ceramic interior that requires less oil for vegetables, salmon, and more. Easy-grip handles provide balance when lifting while rolled rims resist warping even after repeated use.Make baking a fun family activty with this colorful set of baking essentials! Handwash only.
